name: Save & Analyze sends only the documents marked Analyze to LendPathway
description:
Objective: Save & Analyze sends only the documents marked Analyze to LendPathway.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Fill a New application and upload the loan application and 3 bank statements.
2. Mark one statement Don't Analyze.
3. Save & Analyze.
Expected: The selection holds only the Analyze documents, LendPathway submit succeeds, the application gets a LendPathway book and only the Analyze documents sync.
